verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.yapily.com/llms.txt with a structured index of markdown doc pages, which hands-on confirms the documented llms.txt claim. Yapily also has a dedicated AI-agents page explaining how to connect Claude, Cursor or other coding agents to the docs via MCP, llms.txt or Agent Skills, and the MCP connection gives agents live, searchable access. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents work well with these docs, and evidence of fuller agent-oriented content such as an llms-full.txt or details of the Agent Skills.
